title_zh: 选定围栏外的牛群观察位置

scenario.goal_zh: 说明不愿进入牛场的顾虑，并选择围栏外的观察台

context_zh: 农场参观者与工作人员讨论如何观察正在放牧的牛群。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: I'd like to see the cattle, but I'm cautious around animals that large. Do we have to go into their field?

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: No. Visitors stay on this side of the fence. There's a viewing platform beside the gate.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Can I see the calves from there too?

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Yes. They're resting near the far trough, and the platform gives you a clear view.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: I'll watch from the platform, then. I won't open the gate.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: That's the right choice for the visit. I'll point out the calves when you get there.
